description: One normalized-result discovery registry over pluggable providers: web (the ADR-0035 search trio), YouTube flat search, site presets, and external MCP servers speaking the discovery contract. Results are suggestions rendered in chat — never auto-imported, never persisted. Provider shapes are the study profile recorded in the charter; MCP legs run out-of-process (T3), rows validated and capped.
author: Neuronection
